title.en: An Act to Amend Section three of Act Numbered Twenty-Four Hundred and Twenty-Seven, as Amended By Act Numbered thirty-Six Hundred and Ninety-Six, By Inserting therein the Minors Enabling Clause.

text.en:
Section three of Act Numbered Twenty-four hundred and twenty-seven, as amended by section
one of Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and ninety-six is hereby further amended by adding at the end
thereof and in a separate paragraph the following:
"Any minor of the age of eighteen years or more, may notwithstanding such minority, contract for life, health
and accident insurance, with any insurance company duly licensed to do business in the Philippine Islands,
provided the insurance is taken on his own life and the beneficiary appointed is the minor's estate or the
minor's father, mother, husband, wife, child, brother or sister. The said insured may borrow money from the
insurance company with the guaranty of the insurance policy in an amount not exceeding the cash surrender
value of the policy."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 13, 1931.
